description: This file defines validation support structures, enums, and macros for the FreeType font rendering library, including validation levels, validator structure, and error handling macros.

methods.name: ft_validator_init
methods.description: Initializes a validation object with base address, limit, and validation level.

methods.name: ft_validator_run
methods.description: Executes the validation process; note that it is marked as broken and unsafe for invalid fonts.

methods.name: ft_validator_error
methods.description: Sets an error in the validator and performs a long jump to handle the error.
